rules.statement: Upon the death of an applicant, a specified heir may substitute as the applicant for land acquisition under section 71 of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963 as amended.
rules.supporting_quote: Upon the death of an applicant for the acquisition of a land under section 71 of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963 as amended, there can be substitution of a "Specified heir" viz. a person mentioned in Section 71(2)(a) - in the prescribed order of priority - as well as of a testate heir.
